name: Kōge (Fukuoka, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kōge town emblem in blue, green and red: a blue crescent with blue, green and red diagonal stripes.
history: Municipal flag of Kōge, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 2005.

features.role: Kōge town emblem — a blue crescent with blue, green and red diagonal stripes
